name: super-productivity
label: Super Productivity
installNotes: --legacy-peer-deps because libraries declare peer ranges like ^22.0.0 that npm says a prerelease doesn't satisfy; --min-release-age=0 overrides the repo's .npmrc, which refuses packages younger than three days, and the pinned Angular prerelease is newer than that. build-packages.js is the app's own prebuild step: it bundles the plugins under packages/plugin-dev into src/assets/bundled-plugins, which the app loads at startup; without them every tool logs a 404 per plugin.
notes: Angular CLI app on the application builder, npm workspaces. Its development configuration is a JIT build (aot: false), which is what ng serve runs; its production build is AOT with a service worker.
tsNotes: No .ts edit: the Today view renders no string literal from a component class (its text comes from translation files), so there is nothing a class edit could change that the harness can see.
